footer.description: Developing students since 1997. Empowering the next generation of engineers, leaders, and innovators at Transilvania University.

hero.tag: Board of European Students of Technology
hero.subtitle: Developing students since 1997.
hero.description: BEST Brașov is a non-governmental organization established in 1997 for students at Transilvania University. We bridge the gap between academia, students, and industry while fostering both professional and personal growth.

local.heading: We started here, in Brașov.
local.p1: Established in 1997, BEST Brașov bridges the gap between students, academia, and the corporate world at Transilvania University. Our focus is the professional and personal development of every member.
local.p2: We organize tailored events—workshops, academic courses, and company presentations—designed to meet the real-world needs of students.
local.p3: Beyond academics, we build a tightly-knit community through dynamic social activities and teambuildings.

international.heading: But the story is much bigger.
international.p1: BEST (Board of European Students of Technology) was founded in 1989 and operates across 85 universities in 30 countries. We connect tech-passionate students on an international scale.
international.p2: Through our vast network, we facilitate academic exchanges, seasonal courses, and unique networking opportunities with top professionals.
international.p3: We drive innovation by organizing technical competitions (like EBEC), trainings, and workshops spanning engineering, IT, robotics, and design.

whatWeDo.title: What do we do?
whatWeDo.subtitle: Empowering students through three core initiatives.

pillars.title: Complementary Education
pillars.description: We offer excellent opportunities for further education in an international environment. Our seasonal courses allow students to deepen their knowledge while working in interdisciplinary teams.

pillars.title: Career Support
pillars.description: We provide valuable career development support. Through events like BEST Company Day, we connect students directly with top companies to showcase opportunities and kickstart careers.

pillars.title: Educational Involvement
pillars.description: We are actively involved in education through technical competitions like EBEC. We encourage students to apply their skills in competitive environments, fostering critical thinking and teamwork.

items.title: FUN
items.desc: We love what we do, and we want everyone who participates in our activities and events to feel the same.

items.title: FRIENDSHIP
items.desc: We build lasting relationships, standing by each other through good times and bad times.

items.title: FLEXIBILITY
items.desc: We are open to new ideas. Whatever happens, we seek solutions to adapt.

items.title: OPEN MINDEDNESS
items.desc: We aim to improve ourselves every day. If we become better, then those around us also evolve.

items.title: IMPROVEMENT
items.desc: We learn from every experience, event, or even a simple conversation with another BEST member.

departmentsPage.subtitle: Discover our departments and find the one that sparks your passion. Click on any card to see what happens behind the scenes!

items.name: Human Resources
items.motto: Are you a sociable person who loves being around people and making friends easily? Or maybe you're on the shy side and want a safe space to practice your social skills? In BEST, you'll have the perfect chance to develop your soft skills, learn to interact with diverse personalities, and organize the most memorable activities for your friends!
items.desc: This department takes care of the organization's members: from outings, parties, and teambuildings, to training and other activities that develop you. In addition, they are also in charge of constantly evaluating what we do, so that we can constantly improve our work.

items.name: Fundraising
items.motto: Negotiations? Corporate meetings? If you want to overcome the fear of communicating in a professional environment and master negotiation techniques that will give you a massive head start in your future career, FR is exactly where you belong!
items.desc: Those involved in this department ensure that we have the material and financial means to carry out our projects. They contact and negotiate with companies to convince them to sponsor our events or offer us prizes and discounts for participants.

items.name: Marketing
items.motto: Design? Video editing? Constantly scrolling through social media trends? If you want to dive into digital marketing, product design, and public speaking, or if you're just looking for a space to unleash your imagination and apply your skills creatively, PR is waiting for you!
items.desc: The members of this department are in charge of the organization's external image, from poster design, to promotional materials, articles, social media presence and podcasts, to maintaining relationships with stakeholders (the University, partners and students).

items.name: Information Technology
items.motto: Websites? Apps? If you want to level up your organization skills and acquire hard skills that will boost any career path in a future-proof field, IT is for you! Join us to collaborate on exciting projects alongside passionate team members.
items.desc: Here you have the opportunity to learn how to create a website and how to take into account all the details related to the resources with which an event is organized. You can also develop yourself in the robotics area, working on interesting projects alongside the other members of the department!

items.question: What is BEST Brașov?
items.answer: BEST (Board of European Students of Technology) is a non-profit, non-political organization. We help students develop their skills, travel, and connect with companies across Europe.

items.question: Who can join the organization?
items.answer: Any student currently enrolled at Transilvania University of Brașov can apply during our recruitment periods (usually in Autumn and Spring).

items.question: Are the courses and travels really free?
items.answer: Mostly, yes! For BEST courses, accommodation, food, and the academic program are covered by the host local group. You usually only pay a small fee and your travel expenses.

items.question: Do I need to be an IT/Computer Science student?
items.answer: Absolutely not! While we focus on technology, our members come from all faculties. We need people skilled in HR, PR, Design, Marketing, Logistics, and more.

items.question: How much time does it take to be a member?
items.answer: It's entirely up to you. You can dedicate a few hours a week or get heavily involved in organizing massive events. Flexibility is key, as we are all full-time students.

header.subtitle: We organize events to build bridges between students, universities, and companies. Discover what's coming up next!

publicEvents.title: Public Events
publicEvents.subtitle: Open to all students across the university.

internalEvents.title: Internal Events
internalEvents.subtitle: Exclusive activities for active BEST members.

bit.title: BIT
bit.desc: BEST Information Technology, an event now in its eighth edition, aims to develop a link between IT companies, the university environment and Brașov students, through dynamic activities, such as: company presentations, workshops, competitions and shows & tell.

hackathon.title: Hackathon
hackathon.desc: A Hackathon is a programming competition where participants use their skills and knowledge to solve a specific problem. In the winter of 2019, the first Hackathon organized by BEST Brașov took place, an event in which we put the students’ IT knowledge to the test in a 24-hour interval.

btw.title: BTW
btw.desc: BEST Training Week is an educational event organized by BEST Brasov for students from Transilvania University. The event consists of free training sessions, mostly focused on the soft skills side of the future graduates and is meant to help their personal development and training, in order to initiate them into a successful career path.

bcds.title: BCDs
bcds.desc: BEST Career Days is an event dedicated to Transilvania University students, an event in which you will have the opportunity to interact with employers and companies in order to develop your own knowledge, but you can also have the opportunity to get an internship or even a job, to take a step towards the career you want.

bcd.title: BCD
bcd.desc: BEST Company Day is an event addressed to students from the Transilvania University of Brașov, being dedicated to opportunities to interact with specialists and employees in the technical field in order to develop their own knowledge. There is also the possibility of getting an internship or even a job.

courses.title: BEST Courses
courses.desc: During the year, BEST organizes various activities where students from technical universities have the opportunity to have an international experience, to make new friends and contacts, to improve their English and of course, to have fun. Each BEST event is attended by approximately 20-30 students who have one thing in common: they want to have a unique experience different from college life.

gala.title: Anniversary Gala
gala.desc: The Anniversary Gala is an event that we organize every 5 years, the most recent one was last year when we celebrated 25 years of activity. Within it, we present our activity to all partners, be they technical or academic, and publicly thank them for all the help provided.

mw.title: Motivation Weekend
mw.desc: Motivational Weekend is a 3-day event meant to integrate new members of our organization. It is held twice a year, usually after the recruitment period. During this event, BEST Brasov’s members take part in different activities, such as trainings, traditions of our organization and so on and so forth.

ai.title: Internal Anniversary
ai.desc: Internal Anniversary is an event where BEST Brasov’s members celebrate another year of organization’s existence. Besides that, we honour our new alumni members. New members but not only can interact with the old ones to learn some of their stories and experiences within the organization.

hero.subtitle: Step out of your comfort zone, travel across Europe, develop skills they don't teach you in classes, and meet the best friends you'll ever have.

items.title: Level Up Your Skills

items.title: Awesome Community
items.desc: Make lifelong friends, go on epic teambuildings, and surround yourself with ambitious people who want more from their student life.

items.title: Career Boost
items.desc: Connect directly with top companies, organize massive events, and build a CV that will easily stand out to any employer.
